Boboboubo Boubobo - Bakutou Hajike Taise.name: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo: Bakutou Hajike Taisen
Boboboubo Boubobo - Bakutou Hajike Taise.summary: Boboboubo Boubobo: Bakutou Hajike Taisen is an Action game, published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Castlevania - Circle of the Moon.name: Castlevania: Circle of the Moon
Castlevania - Circle of the Moon.summary: Castlevania: Circle of the Moon is the first of the series to be based on the action/RPG structure of Castlevania:Symphony of the Night rather than the level-based action style of all previous Castlevania games. Dracula's castle is a single continuous building, and as Nathan discovers artifacts within it he gains new abilities that allow him to explore more of it. While Nathan can only use his Killer Whip as a weapon, he can find and equip different kinds of armor and accessories that change his stats. Unique to this entry in the series is the Dual Set-up System, where a combination of two cards will give Nathan unique magical abilities. For example, equipping a fire type card with a whip card will give the Killer Whip a fire attribute, while equipping it with a summon card will let Nathan summon a fire demon to attack onscreen enemies.

Dragon Ball GT - Transformation.name: Dragon Ball GT: Transformation
Dragon Ball GT - Transformation.summary: Dragon Ball GT: Transformation is a Game Boy Advance action game based on the Japanese cartoon Dragon Ball GT. Transformation follows the Dragon Ball GT storyline from the Child Goku Saga to the Baby Saga. You can create three-man teams from seven playable characters--such as Goku, Trunks, and Uub--and choose who you control in the middle of a battle.

Looney Tunes Double Pack.name: Looney Tunes Double Pack
Looney Tunes Double Pack.summary:
Looney Tunes Double Pack is a game for the Game Boy Advance that consists of two different (but new) Looney Tunes Games.

Looney Tunes - Dizzy Driving
Looney Tunes - Acme Antics

M&M's - Break' Em.name: M&M's Break 'Em
M&M's - Break' Em.summary: Mr. Runch, a rotten and dangerous peanut, fiercely determined on being one of the M&M's, just escaped the reject bin where he was discarded as ghastly! He's on the loose in the Galaxy, and trying to kidnap and trap all of the M&M's into crystals until he can get what he wants: the chance to become a real M&M's candy!

Shingata Medarot - Kuwagata Version.name: Shingata Medarot: Kuwagata Version
Shingata Medarot - Kuwagata Version.summary: Shingata Medarot is a remake of the first Medarot and was the last game in the series until its DS entry years later. Its art style is a huge departure from its predecessors'.
